profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Technician with 6+ years experience looking to transition to software development.

Quick to learn new skills as the industry rapidly evolved and train others with different backgrounds. Detail-oriented with the ability to guide clients through the conclusion of their events. Adept at managing limited resources with tight time constraints.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Vue.js · Spring Boot · Spring Batch · Java · Kotlin · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Design · MongoDB · MariaDB · Playwright · Agentic AI · Generative AI · JavaScript · TypeScript

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for Data Structures & Software Design, Introduction to Computer Systems, Computer
Systems Programming, and Internet & Web Systems courses.

Assisted students with course concepts and with Java and C homework and projects

positions.title: Technical Assistant
positions.description:
Led infrastructure workgroup responsible for long term planning for building updates and maintenance.
Maintained video and projection equipment.
Planned, installed, and deployed production network.
Oversaw replacement of audio backend network.
Interfaced with clients before event for media and technology needs.
Worked with clients and managed crew to ensure event success.
positions.insights: Skills: Audio Visual System Design · Stage Lighting · Audio Visual (AV) Systems

positions.title: Ticket Services Associate
positions.description: Sell and exchange individual tickets in advance and before shows; Sell, process, and seat season tickets: over the phone and in person.

positions.description: Rented Kayaks and Rowing Shells on Brushy Creek Lake

volunteerExperiences.description:
In charge of the volunteer security team at the Ascendio 2012 Harry Potter Symposium. 

At prior conventions volunteered as the Security Assistant Chair at Infinitus 2010 and Azkatraz 2009, and a security/general volunteer at Portus 2008.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: University Co-op presents Cohen New Works Festival
volunteerExperiences.description:
Maintain and update the New Works Festival website, post content provided by Producers and other ExCom members.

Help to expand web presence of the Festival

Look at new internet sites/applications and how they could work for the festival in close collaboration with PR/Marketing Chair(s)

Expand the usefulness of the Festival website for audiences, participants, and the Executive Committee
